standard.summary: ControlNet-LLLite 是 ControlNet 的轻量替代——在 UNet 上注入小型适配器来接收条件图像，参数量远少于完整 ControlNet。
standard.effect: lllite_cond_emb_dim 控制条件图像的嵌入维度（默认 32）。lllite_mlp_dim 控制适配器的瓶颈维度（默认 64）。lllite_dropout 控制适配器内的 dropout。
standard.whenToUse: 想用轻量方案训练 ControlNet 类控制模型时。参数量只有完整 ControlNet 的 1-5%。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要精确控制时（轻量方案控制力弱于完整 ControlNet）。

standard_en.summary: ControlNet-LLLite is a lightweight alternative to ControlNet -- small adapters injected into the UNet receive the conditioning image, with far fewer parameters than a full ControlNet.
standard_en.effect: lllite_cond_emb_dim sets the conditioning image's embedding dimension (32 by default). lllite_mlp_dim sets the adapter's bottleneck dimension (64 by default). lllite_dropout sets dropout inside the adapter.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want a lightweight way to train a ControlNet-style control model. It has only 1-5% of a full ControlNet's parameters.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need precise control -- the lightweight approach controls less firmly than a full ControlNet.

advanced.principle: LLLite 在 UNet 的多个层注入小型适配器，每个适配器接收条件图像的 embedding 并通过 MLP 注入到 UNet 的中间层。lllite_skip_input_blocks/skip_output_blocks 控制是否跳过 input/output block 的注入（减少参数量）。条件图像通过 CLIP image encoder 或自定义 encoder 编码后注入。
advanced.intervention: UNet forward 时在注入点将条件 embedding 通过 MLP 变换后叠加到特征图上。
advanced.expectedImpact: 文件大小约 10-50MB（vs 完整 ControlNet 的 1.4GB）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 控制精度不如完整 ControlNet。

advanced_en.principle: LLLite injects small adapters at several UNet layers; each adapter takes the conditioning image's embedding and injects it through an MLP into UNet intermediate layers. lllite_skip_input_blocks/skip_output_blocks control whether input/output block injection is skipped (fewer parameters). The conditioning image is encoded via a CLIP image encoder or a custom encoder before injection.
advanced_en.intervention: At UNet forward, the conditioning embedding is transformed through the MLP at injection points and added to feature maps.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: File size roughly 10-50MB (vs 1.4GB for a full ControlNet).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Control precision below a full ControlNet.
